description:
Situated on the top floor of the highly sought-after Manolis Yard development, nestled between bustling Bold Street and thriving Seel Street, this duplex apartment is a truly beautiful home with unrivalled panoramic views across the city's skyline.  This property is located in the heart of Liverpool's City Centre and offers an ideal location for the vast array of amenities Liverpool has to offer, including The Liverpool One and Met Quarter Shopping Centre and of course many bars and restaurants.

The property has a myriad of unique features with balconies to both levels complemented by a sprawling roof terrace, giving fabulous outside entertaining space in addition to the beautifully designed internal accommodation offering.

Secure underground bay allocated parking included.

The property has recently benefited from redecoration throughout, kitchen upgrade and air-conditioning. New photographs and video tour to follow.

Communal Entrance 
Secure entrance. Stairs and lift to all floors.

Entrance Hallway
Wood effect engineered wood flooring. Video telephone intercom system. Storage cupboard. Large windows offering plenty of light. 

Bedroom 1
Double glazed floor to ceiling windows offering access to the lower decked balcony,  fitted wardrobes, wall mounted electric radiator, television point, custom made fitted curtains and blinds. Wood effect laminate flooring

Master Bathroom 
A three piece fitted suite comprising of w.c, pedestal wash hand basin with mixer tap over and panelled bath with mixer shower over in a tiled surround and glazed screen, fully tiled bathroom, heated towel rail and shaver point

Hallway leading to master 
Wood effect laminate flooring

Bedroom 2 - Primary Bedroom
An exceptionally large double bedroom with fully tiled en-suite shower room, double glazed windows offering access to the lower decked balcony, fitted king size bed,  fitted wardrobes, wall mounted electric radiator, television point, custom made fitted curtains and blinds. Wood effect laminate flooring

Bedroom 3 
Double glazed windows, fitted wardrobes, wall mounted electric radiator, television point, custom made fitted curtains and blinds. Wood effect laminate flooring

Lower Balcony 
Timber decked balcony

Wooden Spiral Staircase Leading from Ground to First Floor with large windows offering plenty of light. 

Kitchen
Fully fitted and integrated kitchen (electric oven, 4 ring hob, extractor, washer dryer and fridge freezer) with worktop, steel sink and drainer with mixer tap over tiled splash back.  Tiled flooring. Dining area with large windows offering plenty of light. 

Top Floor Bathroom 
A three piece fitted suite comprising of w.c, pedestal wash hand basin with mixer tap over and shower cubicle in a tiled surround and glazed screen, fully tiled bathroom, heated towel rail and shaver point

Hallway Storage 
x 2 large storage cupboards, one containing boiler. Plenty of storage available. Both carpeted.

Lounge
Unrivalled panoramic views across the city's skyline. Floor to ceiling double glazed windows, wall mounted electric radiator, television point, custom made fitted curtains and blinds, carpeted. Access to the upper balcony.

Upper Balcony
Timber decked balcony offering access to the main roof terrace with 360 degree views of Liverpool City Centre and beyond.

Electric Heating Throughout.

Property Type: Apartment ( 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom)
Tenure: Leasehold
No of Floors: 2
EPC Rating D61
Local Authority: Liverpool City Council
Council Tax Band E

Appliances/White Goods: Electric Oven, Electric Hob (Ceramic), Fridge/Freezer, Dishwasher
